title: Surface Roughness Analysis - Haze Detection on Candela 8520
subtitle: Post-Anneal Quality Validation for 45nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Yuki Tanaka

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Candela 8520 system to detect and classify Haze defects during post-anneal inspection at the 45nm technology node. The test is conducted at Chandler Fab 42 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Haze defects that are critical to yield at the 45nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Candela 8520 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Candela 8520
- Inspection Type: Surface Roughness Analysis
- Target Defect: Haze
- Process Step: Post-Anneal
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 45nm
- Fab Location: Chandler Fab 42

This test case applies to all Candela 8520 systems deployed at Chandler Fab 42 for post-anneal monitoring in the 45nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Candela 8520
Software Version: v13.2.378
Recipe: SURFACE_ROUGHNESS_ANALYSIS_45nm_POST_ANNEAL
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Low (163 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Candela 8520 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Surface Roughness Analysis' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Haze defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 45nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 54 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 91% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±1.4% for Surface Roughness Analysis
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.97 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-07-10
Wafers Tested: 36
Total Defects Found: 1044
Defect Density: 332.32 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 5.8%
Capture Rate: 97.0%
Test Duration: 109 minutes
System Uptime: 96.4%

Result Classification: CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Candela 8520 demonstrated acceptable performance in detecting Haze at the 45nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Edge-zone defect detection showed improved performance compared to previous revision.

e) Recipe portability between systems at this fab was confirmed.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
